sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
- Improve road safety at the Parker Street and Stafford Street intersection by reducing the risk of serious crashes and conflict points.
- Restrict right-turn and through movements at Stafford Street through median reconstruction, creating a left-in/left-out intersection arrangement.
- Reduce the likelihood of vehicles crossing multiple high-speed traffic lanes on Parker Street.
- Improve traffic efficiency by extending right-turn lanes into Jamison Road and Derby Street using the existing Stafford Street right-turn bays.
- Enhance driver awareness and compliance through the installation of new regulatory and directional signage.
- Upgrade drainage, pavement, median infrastructure and associated roadworks to meet current Transport for NSW standards.
- Deliver a safer and more reliable transport network for motorists while minimising future crash occurrences at this location.
